Descriptor reflects the data role (a frame index/counter). No Ghidra address residue (no hex suffix equal to its own or any data address). 'frame_idx' correctly conveys it is the internal mouth-animation frame index.
purpose: Internal frame counter for the talking-portrait mouth animation in fd2_portrait_blink_animation_step.
logic_summary: Advanced once every 2 calls of fd2_portrait_blink_animation_step (gated by the subtick divider at 0x53A14). Cycles 0 -> 1 -> 2 -> 3 -> 0 (mod 4). When painted, internal frame 3 is collapsed to visible frame 1, producing the visible mouth sequence 0/1/2/1. Pure runtime state relying on zero-initialization at startup (the 0..3 cycle is only correct starting from 0).
element_semantics: Single unsigned 32-bit counter. Accessed exclusively as dword ptr (INC at 0x16501, CMP ...,0x4 at 0x16507, MOV ...,0 at 0x16510 wrap-reset, MOV EAX,[...] at 0x1651A for the visible-collapse compare). Holds the internal animation frame index in range 0..3.
